beats.headline: A city named on the surface
beats.text: Carl and Donut come up out of the water with the concierge sharks behind them and once they reach a town that will take them in, Katia reads the Mad Dune Mage's page of numbers as places the Gate can open onto, every one of them around Larracos, the capital city four floors below them. Mordecai points out that a crawler cannot use it to skip ahead. All it would do is let something out.

beats.headline: The water goes down the hole
beats.text: The plan was never a feral god. The Gate opens in the water quadrant, and a bubble's ocean, a load of timed charges and a feeding frenzy of sharks pour through it into Larracos's faction market. By Katia's math more than half of the inverted city is under water by the time the gate closes; only the upper levels, the NPC residences, are spared. Zev warns that the markets, the mercenaries and the Desperado Club's entrance bar are all down there. Juice Box flies for the gate and goes through with the water.

beats.headline: Still not drained
beats.text: Clarabelle, at the club door, says the level below the Hunting Grounds is still under water. Something keeps clogging the drains, and the sharks are not helping. The outworlders trapped on the Larracos level have the hotel and the main casino, so nobody is complaining much, but the weapons brokers who usually buy a pass up to trade with the hunters have not managed it once. They were trying to drain it before the floor ended. It does not look like they will.

beats.headline: The victory party, seen from the rubble
beats.text: A ninth-edition note from Rosetta in the Cookbook: when the viceroys pull out a last-minute victory, a portal opens, and the orcs, the viceroys, the operatics and the nagas step through together, laughing, off to a victory party in a nightclub on another floor. They drag unwilling NPCs with them, the librarian elves from the college among them. A crawler who tries to follow hits the portal like glass. The orc prince steps back into the smoldering remains of Larracos, lassoes him, and the rope cuts him in half on the way back through.

beats.headline: Home Team, based in Larracos
beats.text: One of the viewers' votes seats a tenth team, populated with NPCs and given the same protections as the other nine. It is designated Home Team, its base is the city of Larracos, and peace rules apply there effectively immediately, until the game starts. Its co-warlords are the NPCs Juice Box and Sir Ferdinand. An adjutant is to be assigned before the battles begin. It passes by fifty-two percent.

beats.headline: The crawl arrives inside it
beats.text: Crawlers come down into Larracos at the start of a sixty-hour ceasefire. The armies that have spent eight floors drilling and drinking are allowed to fight one another at last, and the thing they are fighting over is underfoot: the castle at the bottom of the well.

beats.headline: Arief's tour
beats.text: War Leader Arief walks the group down from the college on level fifty through a city whose floodwater has fallen to its bottom three levels, still high enough to cover the castle. Juice Box has been waking its NPCs to the truth of what they are.

beats.headline: Zerzura
beats.text: The Sledge casts Zerzura and the city goes: Larracos and the shanty town outside its walls lifted whole and set down on the twelfth floor, NPC team and all. The outworlders who were standing in it are put out of the dungeon instead.
